title: Prognosticating salvage stereotactic radiosurgery outcomes in relapsed primary central nervous system lymphoma: A machine learning-driven decision tree analysis.
summary: A C5.0 decision tree trained on 209 retrospective SRS-salvage cases with a stratified 144/65 training/validation split and reported response-class sensitivities/specificities. The study does not establish external generalization, causal effects or sustained operational impact.

evidence.tested: C5.0 learned a response tree using KPS, deep-structure involvement and IELSG score; a held-out validation subset was evaluated.
evidence.unknown: This is single-center retrospective internal validation; it supports prediction in the studied cohort, not prospective decision impact.
